```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)
```

```{r load-data, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(shiny)
library(leaflet)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(rnaturalearth)
library(ggplot2)
library(bslib)
library(jsonlite)

# Read malaria data
global_raw <- read_csv(
  "Brianna/estimated_number_of_malaria_cases_2000-2015.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

europe_raw <- read_csv(
  "Brianna/estimated_number_of_WHO_europe_malaria_cases_2000-2015.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

# Read medical doctor data
doctors_raw <- read_csv(
  "Brianna/WHO_global_medical_doctors_per_10,000_(varying_year_ranges).csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

# Fetch population data from Our World in Data
df <- read.csv(
  "https://ourworldindata.org/grapher/population-unwpp.csv?v=1&csvType=full&useColumnShortNames=true"
)

# Fetch population metadata
metadata <- fromJSON(
  "https://ourworldindata.org/grapher/population-unwpp.metadata.json?v=1&csvType=full&useColumnShortNames=true"
)
```

```{r data-prep}
# Prepare global malaria data
global_cases <- global_raw %>%
  transmute(
    iso3 = SpatialDimValueCode,
    country = Location,
    year = as.integer(Period),
    cases = as.numeric(FactValueNumeric)
  ) %>%
  filter(year >= 2000, year <= 2015)

# Prepare WHO European malaria data
europe_cases <- europe_raw %>%
  transmute(
    iso3 = SpatialDimValueCode,
    country = country,
    year = as.integer(year),
    cases = as.numeric(FactValueNumeric)
  ) %>%
  filter(year >= 2000, year <= 2015)

# Prepare available-country global trend
global_trend <- global_cases %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(
    countries_with_data = sum(!is.na(cases)),
    cases = if (all(is.na(cases))) {
      NA_real_
    } else {
      sum(cases, na.rm = TRUE)
    },
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Prepare WHO European Region trend
europe_trend <- europe_cases %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(
    countries_with_data = sum(!is.na(cases)),
    cases = if (all(is.na(cases))) {
      NA_real_
    } else {
      sum(cases, na.rm = TRUE)
    },
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# WHO European Region country ISO3 codes
europe_iso3 <- c(
  "ALB", "AND", "ARM", "AUT", "AZE", "BLR", "BEL",
  "BIH", "BGR", "HRV", "CYP", "CZE", "DNK", "EST",
  "FIN", "FRA", "GEO", "DEU", "GRC", "HUN", "ISL",
  "IRL", "ISR", "ITA", "KAZ", "KGZ", "LVA", "LTU",
  "LUX", "MLT", "MCO", "MNE", "NLD", "MKD", "NOR",
  "POL", "PRT", "MDA", "ROU", "RUS", "SMR", "SRB",
  "SVK", "SVN", "ESP", "SWE", "CHE", "TJK", "TUR",
  "TKM", "UKR", "GBR", "UZB"
)

# Prepare medical doctor data
# Values are doctors per 10,000 people
doctors_europe <- doctors_raw %>%
  transmute(
    iso3 = SpatialDimValueCode,
    year = as.integer(Period),
    doctors_per_10000 = as.numeric(FactValueNumeric)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    iso3 %in% europe_iso3,
    year >= 2000,
    year <= 2015
  ) %>%
  group_by(iso3, year) %>%
  summarise(
    doctors_per_10000 = if (all(is.na(doctors_per_10000))) {
      NA_real_
    } else {
      mean(doctors_per_10000, na.rm = TRUE)
    },
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Prepare population data
population_data <- df %>%
  transmute(
    iso3 = code,
    year = as.integer(year),
    population = as.numeric(population__sex_all__age_all__variant_estimates)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    iso3 %in% europe_iso3,
    year >= 2000,
    year <= 2015
  ) %>%
  group_by(iso3, year) %>%
  summarise(
    population = mean(population, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Match malaria, doctor, and population data
resource_comparison <- europe_cases %>%
  group_by(iso3, country, year) %>%
  summarise(
    cases = if (all(is.na(cases))) {
      NA_real_
    } else {
      mean(cases, na.rm = TRUE)
    },
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  inner_join(
    doctors_europe,
    by = c("iso3", "year")
  ) %>%
  inner_join(
    population_data,
    by = c("iso3", "year")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    malaria_per_100000 = (cases / population) * 100000,
    is_azerbaijan = iso3 == "AZE"
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(doctors_per_10000),
    !is.na(malaria_per_100000),
    !is.na(population),
    population > 0
  )

# Map data
world <- ne_countries(
  scale = "medium",
  returnclass = "sf"
) %>%
  mutate(
    iso3 = if_else(iso_a3 == "-99", adm0_a3, iso_a3)
  ) %>%
  select(iso3, name, geometry)

# Map color palette
case_palette <- colorNumeric(
  palette = c(
    "#21113D",
    "#63318E",
    "#B536A0",
    "#F15BB5",
    "#FFD166"
  ),
  domain = europe_cases$cases,
  na.color = "#30303A"
)
```

```{r map-functions}
# Prepare map data for the selected year
make_map_data <- function(selected_year) {

  world %>%
    filter(iso3 %in% europe_iso3) %>%
    left_join(
      europe_cases %>%
        filter(year == as.integer(selected_year)),
      by = "iso3"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      is_azerbaijan = iso3 == "AZE"
    )
}

# Draw the malaria map
draw_malaria_map <- function(selected_year) {

  map_data <- make_map_data(selected_year)

  leaflet(
    map_data,
    options = leafletOptions(preferCanvas = TRUE)
  ) %>%
    addTiles() %>%
    setView(lng = 35, lat = 48, zoom = 3) %>%

    addPolygons(
      group = "country-polygons",
      layerId = ~iso3,
      fillColor = ~case_palette(cases),
      fillOpacity = 0.9,
      color = ~ifelse(is_azerbaijan, "#FF3CAC", "#55515F"),
      weight = ~ifelse(is_azerbaijan, 4, 0.8),

      label = ~paste0(
        name,
        ifelse(is_azerbaijan, " ★ FOCUS COUNTRY", ""),
        ": ",
        ifelse(
          is.na(cases),
          "No estimate available",
          format(round(cases), big.mark = ",")
        ),
        " Estimated Cases"
      ),

      highlightOptions = highlightOptions(
        weight = 4,
        color = "#FFD166",
        bringToFront = TRUE
      )
    ) %>%

    addLabelOnlyMarkers(
      data = sf::st_point_on_surface(
        map_data %>% filter(is_azerbaijan)
      ),
      label = ~"AZERBAIJAN",
      labelOptions = labelOptions(
        noHide = TRUE,
        direction = "top",
        textOnly = TRUE,
        style = list(
          "color" = "#FF3CAC",
          "font-weight" = "bold",
          "font-size" = "12px",
          "text-shadow" = "0 0 5px #000000"
        )
      )
    ) %>%

    addLegend(
      position = "bottomright",
      pal = case_palette,
      values = europe_cases$cases,
      title = "Estimated Cases",
      na.label = "No estimate"
    )
}
```

```{r graph-functions}
# Shared graph appearance
graph_theme <- function() {

  theme_minimal() +

    theme(
      text = element_text(color = "#F5F5F7"),

      plot.background = element_rect(
        fill = "#111118",
        color = NA
      ),

      panel.background = element_rect(
        fill = "#111118",
        color = NA
      ),

      panel.grid.major = element_line(
        color = "#30243F"
      ),

      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),

      axis.text = element_text(
        color = "#D9CDE8"
      ),

      axis.title = element_text(
        color = "#D9CDE8"
      ),

      plot.title = element_text(
        color = "#FF3CAC",
        face = "bold",
        size = 14
      ),

      plot.subtitle = element_text(
        color = "#B9B1C9"
      )
    )
}
```

```{r run-maps, echo=FALSE}
server <- function(input, output, session) {

  # Map
  output$malaria_map <- renderLeaflet({

    draw_malaria_map(input$year)

  })

  # Update map polygons when year changes
  observeEvent(input$year, {

    map_data <- make_map_data(input$year)

    leafletProxy(
      "malaria_map",
      data = map_data
    ) %>%

      clearGroup("country-polygons") %>%

      addPolygons(
        group = "country-polygons",
        layerId = ~iso3,

        fillColor = ~case_palette(cases),
        fillOpacity = 0.9,

        color = ~ifelse(
          is_azerbaijan,
          "#FF3CAC",
          "#55515F"
        ),

        weight = ~ifelse(
          is_azerbaijan,
          4,
          0.8
        ),

        label = ~paste0(
          name,
          ifelse(is_azerbaijan, " ★ FOCUS COUNTRY", ""),
          ": ",
          ifelse(
            is.na(cases),
            "No estimate available",
            format(round(cases), big.mark = ",")
          ),
          " Estimated Cases"
        ),

        highlightOptions = highlightOptions(
          weight = 4,
          color = "#FFD166",
          bringToFront = TRUE
        )
      )

  }, ignoreInit = TRUE)


  # Available-country global trend graph
  output$global_trend <- renderPlot({

    ggplot(
      global_trend,
      aes(x = year, y = cases)
    ) +

      geom_line(
        color = "#FF3CAC",
        linewidth = 1.2
      ) +

      geom_point(
        color = "#FFD166",
        size = 2
      ) +

      scale_x_continuous(
        breaks = 2000:2015
      ) +

      scale_y_continuous(
        labels = function(x) {
          format(
            x,
            big.mark = ",",
            scientific = FALSE
          )
        }
      ) +

      labs(
        title = "Available Global Malaria Estimates",
        x = "Year",
        y = "Estimated Cases"
      ) +

      graph_theme()

  })


  # WHO European Region trend graph
  output$europe_trend <- renderPlot({

    ggplot(
      europe_trend,
      aes(x = year, y = cases)
    ) +

      geom_line(
        color = "#FF3CAC",
        linewidth = 1.2
      ) +

      geom_point(
        color = "#FFD166",
        size = 2
      ) +

      scale_x_continuous(
        breaks = 2000:2015
      ) +

      scale_y_continuous(
        labels = function(x) {
          format(
            x,
            big.mark = ",",
            scientific = FALSE
          )
        }
      ) +

      labs(
        title = "WHO European Region Malaria Estimates",
        x = "Year",
        y = "Estimated Cases"
      ) +

      graph_theme()

  })


  # Azerbaijan summary
  output$azerbaijan_summary <- renderUI({

    az <- europe_cases %>%
      filter(
        iso3 == "AZE",
        year == as.integer(input$year)
      )

    if (nrow(az) == 0 || is.na(az$cases[1])) {

      return(
        p("No estimate available for this year.")
      )

    }

    tagList(

      h4(
        "AZERBAIJAN",
        style = "color:#FF3CAC;"
      ),

      h2(
        format(
          round(az$cases[1]),
          big.mark = ","
        ),
        style = "color:#FFD166;"
      ),

      p("Estimated Malaria Cases"),

      p(
        paste(
          "Selected year:",
          input$year
        )
      )
    )

  })


  # Azerbaijan trend graph
  output$az_trend <- renderPlot({

    az <- europe_cases %>%
      filter(iso3 == "AZE") %>%
      arrange(year)

    ggplot(
      az,
      aes(x = year, y = cases)
    ) +

      geom_line(
        color = "#FF3CAC",
        linewidth = 1.2
      ) +

      geom_point(
        color = "#FFD166",
        size = 2
      ) +

      scale_x_continuous(
        breaks = 2000:2015
      ) +

      scale_y_continuous(
        labels = function(x) {
          format(
            x,
            big.mark = ",",
            scientific = FALSE
          )
        }
      ) +

      labs(
        title = "Azerbaijan: Estimated Cases",
        x = "Year",
        y = "Estimated Cases"
      ) +

      graph_theme()

  })


  
# Healthcare resources vs. malaria scatter plot
output$resource_scatter <- renderPlot({

  plot_data <- resource_comparison %>%
    filter(year == as.integer(input$year))

  # Check that enough countries have data
  if (nrow(plot_data) < 3) {
    return(
      ggplot() +
        annotate(
          "text",
          x = 0,
          y = 0,
          label = "Not enough countries have matching data for this year.",
          color = "#D9CDE8",
          size = 5
        ) +
        xlim(-1, 1) +
        ylim(-1, 1) +
        labs(
          title = paste("Healthcare Resources vs. Malaria Burden:", input$year)
        ) +
        graph_theme() +
        theme(
          axis.title = element_blank(),
          axis.text = element_blank(),
          panel.grid = element_blank()
        )
    )
  }

  # Create scatter plot
  ggplot(
    plot_data,
    aes(
      x = doctors_per_10000,
      y = malaria_per_100000
    )
  ) +

    # Overall trend line
    geom_smooth(
      method = "lm",
      formula = y ~ x,
      color = "#FF3CAC",
      linewidth = 1.2,
      se = FALSE
    ) +

    # Country points
    geom_point(
      aes(color = is_azerbaijan),
      size = 3,
      alpha = 0.85
    ) +

    # Label Azerbaijan
    geom_text(
      data = plot_data %>%
        filter(is_azerbaijan),
      aes(label = "Azerbaijan"),
      color = "#FF3CAC",
      nudge_x = 0.1,
      hjust = 0,
      size = 3.5,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +

    # Point colors
    scale_color_manual(
      values = c(
        "FALSE" = "#FFD166",
        "TRUE" = "#FF3CAC"
      ),
      labels = c(
        "FALSE" = "Other countries",
        "TRUE" = "Azerbaijan"
      ),
      name = "Country"
    ) +

    scale_x_continuous(
      labels = scales::comma
    ) +

    scale_y_continuous(
      labels = scales::comma
    ) +

    labs(
      title = paste(
        "Healthcare Resources vs. Malaria Burden:",
        input$year
      ),
      x = "Medical Doctors per 10,000 People",
      y = "Estimated Malaria Cases per 100,000 People"
    ) +

    graph_theme()

})


  # NEW: Dynamic correlation description
  output$resource_description <- renderText({

    plot_data <- resource_comparison %>%
      filter(year == as.integer(input$year))

    if (nrow(plot_data) < 3) {
      return(
        "There is not enough matching country data to calculate a correlation for this year."
      )
    }

    correlation <- cor(
      plot_data$doctors_per_10000,
      plot_data$malaria_per_100000,
      use = "complete.obs"
    )

    if (is.na(correlation)) {
      return(
        "A correlation could not be calculated for this year."
      )
    }

    strength <- if (abs(correlation) < 0.3) {
      "weak"
    } else if (abs(correlation) < 0.7) {
      "moderate"
    } else {
      "strong"
    }

    direction <- if (correlation < 0) {
      "negative"
    } else if (correlation > 0) {
      "positive"
    } else {
      "near-zero"
    }

    paste0(
      "For ",
      input$year,
      ", the relationship between the number of medical doctors and malaria cases is ",
      strength,
      " and ",
      direction,
      ". Pearson correlation: ",
      round(correlation, 2),
      ". This describes an association, and is not evidence that increasing the number of doctors causes changes in malaria cases. The comparison includes ",
      nrow(plot_data),
      " countries with matching data. It is important to note that the number of medical doctors, an easily accessible metric from WHO, does not reflect availability. Healthcare availability can be influenced by geopolitical relations that should be explored in further studies."
    )

  })

}

shinyApp(
  ui = ui,
  server = server
)
```
